findings.title: Impossible calendar dates are not rejected
findings.why: The regex checks only the shape of the string, and the code relies on `Date.parse` returning NaN for impossible dates. V8 (Node) only checks that the day is between 1 and 31, so '2026-02-30T00:00:00Z' is rolled over to 2026-03-02 and accepted. A request such as 2026-02-30 to 2026-03-05 is therefore quoted and booked on silently shifted dates. The test 'impossible date' only passes because that pair also has end <= start. The same applies to `parseHourUtc` and to `availability`.

findings.title: Long-stay price arithmetic can leave the safe-integer range
findings.why: `full * LONG_STAY_TENTHS + 5` can exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. `addEquipment` accepts any safe-integer dailyPrice, and there is no limit on the number of days. A large price or period then gives an imprecise total. Because `Math.floor` is applied afterwards, the result can be wrong without any error being raised.
